description: Source code for the ICP10125 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including measurement commands, OTP reading, calibration, and sensor data fetching.

methods.name: icp10125_read_otp
methods.description: Reads OTP data from the sensor to obtain calibration constants.

methods.name: icp10125_measure
methods.description: Performs measurement by sending command and reading sensor data with CRC check.

methods.name: icp10125_calc_calibrated_press
methods.description: Calculates calibrated pressure value from raw data and constants.

methods.name: icp10125_calc_calibrated_ambient_temp
methods.description: Calculates calibrated ambient temperature from raw data.

methods.name: icp10125_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for specified channel (temperature or pressure).

methods.name: icp10125_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, including OTP reading.
